name: Skeleton
summary: Shimmering grey shapes that hold the layout while content loads.
description: Use skeletons when you know the shape of what is coming (a list, a profile) and it takes more than a moment. For a short wait or an unknown shape, use a spinner.

classes.name: v-skeleton
classes.description: A block placeholder, 1em tall, with a slow shimmer. Set its size with inline-size and block-size.

classes.name: v-skeleton-text
classes.description: A line of text: slightly shorter, with line spacing.

classes.name: v-skeleton-circle
classes.description: A circle for an avatar, sized by --v-skeleton-size (2.5rem).

states.description: On the skeleton wrapper: the shapes mean nothing to screen readers.
On the region being loaded, removed when the content arrives.

a11y: Hide skeletons with aria-hidden="true" and announce loading separately, e.g. a .v-sr-only "Loading clients" in a role="status" region.
Swap the skeleton for the real content in one go, so focus and reading order do not jump twice.
